content: PDF text extraction for Next.js (near-term add, not v1): Recommendation is unpdf@1.6.2 (April 2026, actively maintained, MIT, 1.2k stars). Ships a serverless build of Mozilla PDF.js, works in Node.js + browser + Cloudflare Workers. API: import { extractText, getDocumentProxy } from 'unpdf'; const pdf = await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer)); const { text } = await extractText(pdf, { mergePages: true }). For Next.js client-side (browser): user selects file -> FileReader/arrayBuffer -> Uint8Array -> getDocumentProxy -> extractText. For server-side (route handler): same pattern but receive the file as FormData. Alternative pdf-parse is Node.js only (no browser, no edge) — wrong for this use case. pdfjs-dist directly works but unpdf is a cleaner API wrapper. Bundle note: unpdf bundles pdfjs so adds ~300KB to the bundle if used client-side; acceptable for a CV upload tool where users expect some load time. Recommended: use client-side extraction only (no server round-trip for the PDF bytes) — send the extracted text to /api/parse, not the raw PDF.
